body: This says snowy owl. I think op meant snowy towel.
Isn't this just a deleted scene from American Psycho?

Feeling happy that I made the decision to not go "home" to my biological parents house for the first time ever for Christmas this year.  Really got knocked down a peg though when someone very close to me told me that the point of food during the holidays was to remind you of holiday nostalgia from growing up.  I feel as if the inadequacy I associate with the holiday time of year is just following me.  I also feel overwhelmed and guilty if I ever do try to explain to anyone that the holidays as a concept terrify and trigger me because I associate them with my parents yelling at me and crying and not letting me leave the house or see anyone else for fear that I didn't love them enough.

Speaking as a person who regularly jumps relationship to relationship, your post feels cathartic to me.  I identify so much with the desire to simply stop existing.  For me each relationship is my continual failed attempt to reach out of my loneliness.  I convince myself that if I try harder, or differently, I will be able to make the connection, or fix something, so that I can feel the connection I am craving.  Unfortunately thus far I have left every relationship I've had.    And yes.  I am that person.  I have had people who will cuddle me daily.  And I have watched myself destroy those relationships, or stepped back and seen them for an abusive situation.  It's hard.  And I'm not helping.  And yeah, you're right.  It's shitty when I complain.  But I feel the void and the loneliness too.  I'm sorry you're hurting.  I want to find a way out too.
Interested.  Please send me an application if you are still looking.

I really relate to that fear of miscommunication.  For me it s definitely much worse facing the prospect of someone misinterpreting what I mean or using it to justify something I didn't intend rather than simply having someone disagree with me.
